about_the_game:
Fight, Adapt, and Survive Across Time. Biorage is an intense story-driven FPS set in a fractured timeline where the rebellious force "Freedom for All Rebellion" clashes against the corporate empire "Tempus Industries". Experience 15 meticulously crafted levels across 5 visually stunning chapters, where time itself is your greatest enemy. After the main character gets trapped by Tempus in a failed mission, you're left isolated—stranded between past, present, and a future spiraling into chaos.

FEATURES:

⏱️ The Main Story is about 1 hour long, the extra modes add up to 10+ hours of gameplay!

🔥 High-Fidelity Story Mode – Battle through 15 handcrafted levels with immersive storytelling and explosive action.
⏳ Time-Warped Warfare – A rebellion vs. corporation conflict that warps reality itself.
💀 10 Extra Challenge Modes – Push your limits with ultra-hard challenges and experimental gameplay twists:

  • Impossible Mode – Don’t try this. Seriously. (No Guns/Melee + No Checkpoints + No Healing + Permadeath + Half Health)

  • Melee Only – Fight with fists and blades. No guns.

  • No Guns, No Melee – Find a way to make enemies take each other out.

  • No Soldiers Mode (Walking Sim) – A combat-free journey through the world, story intact.

  • No Checkpoints - Start the level over if you die.

  • No Healing - Turns the 15 level campaign into careful health management.

  • Permadeath - 1 death and game over plus health is halved.

  • Random Mode – Levels shuffled

  • Backwards Mode – Play the campaign in reverse, from Level 15 to Level 1.

  • Speedrun Mode – No obstacles, no limits. Just pure speed.

Challenge modes remove all dialogue for a pure gameplay experience (except for the Walking Sim, where the story is fully intact).

Are you ready to shatter the limits of time?

DEMO features 1 main story chapter (chapter 2) and 1 extra mode (Impossible mode) for free!

content_descriptors.notes: Blood on walls, blood splatters on ground.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 700 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 710 / AMD Radeon HD 6450 or equivalent (DirectX 10 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD R7 360 or better (DirectX 11)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
